result.summary: Permits running -txindex concurrently with block pruning (-prune) as long as the index does not contain legacy file-offset entries. When a transaction lookup via txindex or GetTransaction targets a block that has been pruned from disk, the lookup returns candidate pruned block hashes. RPC calls (getrawtransaction, gettxoutproof) and the REST /tx endpoint return structured error information containing those block hashes so callers can fetch the missing blocks on demand via getblockfrompeer.
result.problem: Running txindex has historically been blocked on pruned nodes because legacy index entries stored direct file positions on disk. Pruned node operators could not use txindex to locate transactions or service RPC lookups like getrawtransaction without storing the full blockchain on disk.
evidence: Resolves four long-standing issues requesting txindex support on pruned nodes dating back to 2017: #10609, #12651, #16182, and #35240 (PR description).
result.changed_since_previous: Added handling in getrawtransaction with verbosity 2 to gracefully omit fee and prevout information when undo data is absent (e.g. after blocks retrieved via getblockfrompeer), and added release notes.
result.card: Allows Bitcoin Core nodes to run txindex concurrently with block pruning when the index contains no legacy file-offset entries. When a transaction lookup targets a pruned block, GetTransaction, REST, and RPC calls (getrawtransaction, gettxoutproof) surface candidate block hashes in structured error data so callers can fetch the block via getblockfrompeer and retry. It addresses several issues opened since 2017 requesting txindex support on pruned nodes (#10609, #12651, #16182, #35240), building on the index key format changes merged in #35531.

risk.why: Modifies JSON-RPC error formatting by adding an optional data field, alters getrawtransaction and gettxoutproof error responses for pruned blocks, and updates transaction lookup behavior across node RPCs and REST endpoints.
